notes.title: Magnesium Ninja's Next Game
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p][/p][p]Magnesium Ninja is making another game more than 6 years after Overclocked. Here you go:[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3608900/NOMIA/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Well, technically, I'm the artist of Overclocked working on it as a solo dev. If you liked my drawings in 2018, I hope you like my drawings (and writing, and game design) in 2025 even more. [/p][p][/p][p]If you enjoyed Overclocked's fast paced glass-cannon action and rhythmic one-hit gameplay, be prepared for absolutely none of that, because this is actually a cerebral turn-based strategy game.[/p][p][/p][h2]What?[/h2][p][b]NOMIA[/b] is an isometric tactics roguelike. Guide a warrior and a wizard through a mystifying tale using grid-based strategy and deep deckbuilding mechanics. It's like Final Fantasy Tactics meets Slay the Spire.[/p][p][/p][h2]Why?[/h2][p]I love making games and I wanted to make one that was the complete opposite of the last one.[/p][p][/p][h2]What makes this one unique?[/h2][p]You have reliable [b]Action[/b] cards that stay in your hand alongside exciting [b]Gambit[/b] cards which are discarded and drawn each turn. You can take enemy aggro from your ally with your attacks. You can kick enemies off cliffs with knockback cards.[/p][p]As the rogue, you can steal an enemy's self-destruct card and then parry your own self-destruction. As the wizard, you can invert anyone's buffs into debuffs and vice-versa. As the warrior, you can get an infinite-range joust attack that deals more damage the further away you are.[/p][p][/p][h2]Where is Chris, the programmer and writer of Overclocked? Is he alright? Is he safe?[/h2][p]Chris is fine.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for taking the time to read! Wishlists and feedback are always appreciated.[/p]

notes.title: Update 1.0.5 is Live!
notes.content:
This is a small hotfix to an exploit introduced in 1.0.4.

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could jump and dash without friction for a brief period of time in certain situations
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.4 is Live!
notes.content:
This update fixes a couple bugs with Episode 7, and adds a new input scheme targeting speedrunners.

[list]
[*] Added a "Dedicated Dash Button" option that forces the dash button to always result in a dash, even if you release the button early. Dashes can still be held under this input scheme, and will still charge up before releasing
[*] Fixed an exploit where [spoiler]Asterion[/spoiler] could be hit multiple times in a single phase
[*] Fixed a bug where the player could be killed after defeating [spoiler]the final boss[/spoiler], resulting in overlapping death and victory screens
[/list]

[b]Side Note:[/b] Overclocked now has an official speedrunning community! Check out [url=https://www.speedrun.com/Overclocked]https://www.speedrun.com/Overclocked[/url] for more information and a link to the Discord group.


As always, please let us know if you encounter any issues!

notes.title: Update 1.0.3 is Live!
notes.content:
Hot off the heels of 1.0.2, this update fixes a couple additional bugs.

[list]
    [*]Fixed an issue where a death could occasionally be counted twice
    [*]Fixed a crash when completing the final challenge
    [*]Fixed an issue where dying or restarting on the first stage of an episode would disqualify you from getting the "no deaths" achievement for that episode
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.2 is Live!
notes.content:
First of all: a big thank you to everyone who's been playing the game, leaving feedback, and reporting bugs. It's been wonderful watching people experience Overclocked for the first time.

Update 1.0.2 contains fixes and a couple small level tweaks to create a more balanced experience.


[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
[list]
    [*]The "Consequences" and "Final Hero" achievements are now unlockable
            - If you've already completed the final episode, "Consequences" can be unlocked by simply re-watching the final cutscene
            - To unlock "Final Hero", you will need to re-complete the final episode without dying
    [*]A couple of minor rendering issues with the Leaderboard have been resolved
    [*]A couple of stages have received minor tweaks to improve the difficulty ramp
[/list]


Please let us know if you encounter any issues, or if you have feedback on the game. We hope you continue to enjoy your time with Overclocked!

notes.title: Overclocked is Out Now!
notes.content:
After years of work and more than our fair share of tears, Overclocked is officially available for everyone to play!

This is a thrilling moment for all of us, and we hope you enjoy your time with the game.

If you run into any issues, or have questions for us, feel free to message us on the Steam Forums, or on Twitter.

Lastly, if you're looking for some means to support us (beyond sharing your experiences and reviewing the game), feel free to pick up the game's official soundtrack.

A huge thank you to everyone who has supported us over the years.

Have fun!
